data.why: This is a bundled 23andMe-format raw genotype file that the app's SNPs() parser and predict pipeline directly accept via the sidebar file uploader.

goals: Upload my own direct-to-consumer (23andMe-style) genotype file and see where I fall on a 3D PCA plot relative to 1000 Genomes samples
Get a predicted superpopulation and population-level ancestry label for my sample
Compare the discriminative power of the Kidd (55 AISNP) vs Seldin (128 AISNP) marker sets
View predicted ancestry class probabilities for my sample to gauge prediction confidence
Inspect the underlying genotype tables for both the 1000 Genomes reference panel and my own sample

review.summary: The tree follows the app's real workflow: look at the 1000 Genomes AISNP PCA, add a 23andMe sample, read where it sits and its KNN probabilities, then redo it with the other marker panel or resolution. The evidence checks out in every screen I opened, and the app's bugs are honestly reported. Before filing it needs small fixes: correct the wrong branch tags, remove a step that came from the order of this run, and stop presenting the label line that prints 'me' and the Seldin result driven by missing SNPs as real results.
